item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 05/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The monsoon depression over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea is expected to move towards the vicinity of Hainan Island and Beibu Wan gradually in the next couple of days. There will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will still be showers over the coastal areas in the middle and latter parts of this week. Besides, the area of low pressure over the western North Pacific will develop in the next couple of days and move towards the seas east of the Philippines.
